name: browser-use
headline: baoyu cover image automation skill
short_description: Automates cover image generation for documents, improving efficiency for operations teams. Connects to Claude Code for AI-powered image creation, streamlining workflows.
author: jimliu

sections.overview:
Baoyu-cover-image automates the creation of cover images for documents, eliminating manual design work and accelerating document production timelines. The skill integrates with Claude Code to leverage AI-powered image generation capabilities, enabling operations teams to generate professional cover images at scale. This automation reduces the time spent on visual asset creation, allowing teams to focus on content and strategy. By connecting to Claude's image generation features, the skill streamlines document workflows and ensures consistent visual branding across materials.
Automatically generate cover images for blog posts based on the article's content.
Create visually consistent cover images for a series of social media posts.
Enhance marketing materials by generating tailored cover images for promotional campaigns.
Streamline the design process for newsletters by automating cover image creation.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/jimliu/baoyu-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a professional cover image for a [DOCUMENT_TYPE] titled '[TITLE]'. The image should incorporate [KEY_VISUAL_ELEMENTS] and follow the [BRAND_GUIDELINES]. Ensure the design is suitable for [INDUSTRY] and conveys a [MOOD] tone. The output should be in [FILE_FORMAT] with dimensions [DIMENSIONS].
```
Copy

```
Here is a professional cover image for a marketing report titled 'Q3 2023 Campaign Performance Analysis'. The image features a sleek, modern design with a gradient background transitioning from deep blue to teal, incorporating subtle wave patterns to symbolize data flow. The title is prominently displayed in a clean, sans-serif font with a slight shadow for depth. The company logo is positioned in the bottom right corner, adhering to brand guidelines. The overall tone is professional yet dynamic, suitable for the marketing industry. The image is in PNG format with dimensions 1200x628 pixels, ready for use in digital presentations and reports.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
